programmes.d: A foreign exchange student and soccer player's participation in a dangerous game leads to deadly consequences.

When a soldier vanishes from Fort Hood, her family do everything they can to bring attention to her disappearance; Secretary of the Army Ryan McCarthy speaks about the investigation and allegations of sexual assault in the military.
A young father in California calls 911 after being in a shootout in a car full of strangers that injures two people and kills another.
Police investigate when the seemingly storybook romance between a football player and the homecoming queen ends in a death.

The investigation into the death of a woman whose remains were found in her Frisco, Texas, garage leads detectives to a series of suspects with connections to the victim's complicated and secretive life.
A man is shot and killed while picking up his daughter for a court-ordered visit.
An Air Force captain is shot dead leaving police to suspect his wife and her Army sharpshooter lover.
The investigation into the death of a Florida firefighter reveals a tale of secrets, lies and infidelity.
A Kentucky man is convicted of murdering his co-worker; the mystery is considered solved until a stunning disclosure years later turns the closed case upside down.
A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.
Brittany Stork's decades-long quest to find out more about her mother's mysterious death leads to a dramatic courtroom decision; the man at the center of the case tells his side of the story.
The mystery of a successful real estate entrepreneur killed by a car bomb spans nearly two decades.
A tale of sex, betrayal and murder: Inside the deadly love triangle where three became a crowd.
The trial and murder conviction of Jodi Arias and the salacious relationship that ended in tragedy.
A 29-year-old woman goes missing.
A man dies in a shooting incident after tempers flare in a confrontation in Montana's Glacier National Park.
The family members of murdered California entrepreneur Chris Smith speak out; interviews with investigators, Smith's former colleague, and prosecutor Matt Murphy.
A dancer is murdered in her Virginia home; after interviewing a series of suspects, detectives realize the case is much more complicated than previously thought.
When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly.
Lester Holt reports on the mysterious 2005 disappearance of Ray Gricar, a district attorney in Pennsylvania who investigated sex-abuse claims made against Jerry Sandusky in 1998.
The investigation into a newlywed's disappearance focuses on her job as a CIA employee as a possible clue.

After trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a scheduled gig, his family learns his body was abandoned in the remote Colorado Rockies; as the investigation narrows in on two suspects, a second murder catches police by surprise.
